channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Luka Doncic | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Luka Doncic from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Sandro Mamukelashvili on Luka Doncic
item.description:
Sandro Mamukelashvili on Luka Doncic:

“He is probably the best offensive player ever,maybe, I would say, and definitely right now in the league. He has basketball IQ that is off the charts. So I think just being at the right spot, I am sure he is going to find you. He is so unselfish and he is a great guy off the court as well, so I am really looking forward to getting on the court with him and making hopefully a lot of corner threes.”

Sandro Mamukelashvili on Luka Doncic, Sep 29, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves
item.description:
Rob Pelinka:

“It gave JJ and I a chance to really hone in on what our fundamental thesis was to accomplish this offseason. We really wanted to do three things: keep Austin Reaves, we wanted to acquire a franchise center,and then we wanted to retrofit the team with depth and youth of dribble-pass-and-shoot players in free agency to complement Luka Doncic as our leader. We were able to accomplish those things.”

Rob Pelinka on Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves, Sep 26, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Igor Kokoskov on Jason Kidd, Luka Doncic
item.description:
“I don’t have a particularly high opinion of him. Perhaps the best illustration is that, after working with Jason Kidd for a year, I sat down with him and said, ‘Look, I have a history with Luka Doncic and I know him well, we’ve worked together before, and that can certainly help the team, but I am not here working for Luka Doncic, I am working for you, this is your team.’ However, he could never really get over it. It was something in his head, part of his personal issues, which I didn’t want to get involved in,”

Igor Kokoskov on Jason Kidd, Luka Doncic, Sep 15, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Bronny James on Luka Doncic
item.description:
Dončić clearly handled his hosting duties well, which Bronny James indicated during an interview on ESPN LA 710 last week.

“We were with [Dončić]. He was hooking us up and getting us in the right places in Slovenia, seeing the most out of the country,”

Bronny James on Luka Doncic, Sep 9, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Luka Doncic
item.description:
A weakened team, certainly, but one to be respected according to Victor Wembanyama.

“You take the games as they are, the rosters as they are, and the competitive reality means that deep down,I'm a bit gutted not to be playing against Luka (Dončić). But the opportunity will come round again,”

Victor Wembanyama on Luka Doncic, Aug 26, 2026. Source: Olympics.com.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Luka Doncic
item.description:
O’Neal told Heavy on Lakers.

“When you get older, and you’re still playing at a high level, you’re still trying to demand high money;sometimes as a franchise you have to say, ‘Do I want to pay this guy this much money for the next two years, or do I wanna go get younger?’ I knew when they brought in Luka Doncic, they were looking to start over.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Luka Doncic, Aug 8, 2026. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Austin Reaves on Luka Doncic
item.description:
Austin Reaves on Luka Doncic:

“He’s one of my best friends on this planet. I talk to him almost every single day. He sends me videos of his golf swing and asks me what he can do to get better and I tell him I’m not a coach”

Austin Reaves on Luka Doncic, Jul 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Sandro Mamukelashvili on Luka Doncic
item.description:
Khobi Price:Sandro Mamukelashvili on becoming teammates with Luka Doncic:

“Luka and me, born the same year, so like being in Europe, I used to see a lot about Luka and grew up kind of like seeing how good he was and how big he was at that early age. So, it’s cool to just be his teammate now, cause I remember there was rankings in Europe and like I would always see he was always No. 1. So, I was like just trying to get there, get there. Now just being his teammate, it’s amazing and I really do think like he’s going make my life a lot easier.”

Sandro Mamukelashvili on Luka Doncic, Jul 13, 2026. Source: Twitter @khobi_price.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Luka Doncic
item.description:
“He showed that star potential when Luka [Doncic] got hurt, and he won those games against Utah for us, but we were trying to get a star to put next to Luka, and JB’s star had not risen yet,”

Mark Cuban on Luka Doncic, Jun 17, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Michael Finley, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Mark Cuban on the Luka Doncic trade:

“I talked to Patrick (Dumont) about it, you could justtell that Nico just shit on Luka. because some of the stuff that Patrick was telling me was not true. “Yeah. And kudos to (Michael Finley) for really trying to stand up and block it.”

Mark Cuban on Michael Finley, Luka Doncic, Jun 3, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Byron Scott on Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves
item.description:
“You’re 41, 42, 43 years old, right? You got a three-headed monster like you’re talking about. The Lakers, if you want to move on and be a championship team for the next five, six, seven years, you got to build around Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves. You can’t do that if he’s still here. He’s $50 million. That comes off the cap. You can go get two really good basketball players. And young basketball players that can come in there and help.”

Byron Scott on Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves, May 12, 2026. Source: USAToday.com.

item.title: JJ Redick on Luka Doncic
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: JJ Redick on Luka Doncic:

“He was phenomenal this year as a teammate, and a leader...the guy had a tier 1 season relative to the rest of the league”

JJ Redick on Luka Doncic, May 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Luka Doncic
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Luka Doncic:

“It’d be best for everybody if everybody was available all the time. That'd be the best product for the fans, best for me, best for the teams, best for the players. It's obviously not realistic. We go into every series preparing for every possibility.”

Mark Daigneault on Luka Doncic, May 2, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on LeBron James, Mark Cuban, Anthony Davis, Rob Pelinka, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Jeanie Buss on how the Luka Doncic trade went down:

“Dallas wanted Anthony Davis and he was on our team. Conversations started but it was important they remained private….Those conversations started in the beginning of January…Rob Pelinka was able to pull it off all without it leaking to the media because I think Mark Cuban would’ve jumped in front of a train to keep it from happening. Nobody knew including Luka, Anthony Davis, and LeBron James. We had a game in New York that night, the coach knew this was going to happen but he still had to coach the game. It wasn’t a distraction”

Jeanie Buss on LeBron James, Mark Cuban, Anthony Davis, Rob Pelinka, Luka Doncic, May 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on Anthony Davis, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Jeanie Buss:

“[Redick] handles pressure really well. As a former NBA player, playing for Duke University, he's been through a lot and he brings that steadiness, that calmness, that desire to execute, the obsession about basketball. Last year we had a major trade when Anthony Davis left and Luka Doncic joined us, and he didn't miss a beat. He was able to reconfigure and get into a new direction, and I think a lot of rookie head coaches might have been thrown off a lot by that. But instead, JJ rose to the challenge and he continues to do that.”

Jeanie Buss on Anthony Davis, Luka Doncic, Apr 20, 2026. Source: Sirius XM.

item.title: JJ Redick on Luka Doncic
item.description:
Khobi Price:JJ Redick on having Luka Doncic back with the team:

“It's been really nice. He definitely rebounded and passed in some shooting drills. I think having the group together two out of the last three days has been really nice.”

JJ Redick on Luka Doncic, Apr 20, 2026. Source: Twitter @khobi_price.

item.title: Rui Hachimura on Luka Doncic
item.description:
Rui Hachimura on Luka Doncic being back:

“I think people don't know that how much impact that Luka has — not just on the court but off the court.”

Rui Hachimura on Luka Doncic, Apr 20, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: JJ Redick on Austin Reaves, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Lakers coach JJ Redick on Austin Reaves/Luka Doncic playing 2nd half vs OKC:

“As a coach, you go on the information you have. (Luka) was medically cleared. When Austin came back, I asked directly, ‘I thought he was hurt.’(I was told): ‘No, he's medically cleared.’”

JJ Redick on Austin Reaves, Luka Doncic, Apr 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: JJ Redick on Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves
item.description:
Benjamin Royer:Lakers coach JJ Redick on Luka Doncic/Austin Reaves and the rest of the road ahead:

“Both those guys are going to try to come back, and it's our job to extend the season so that they can come back.”

JJ Redick on Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves, Apr 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Mark Cuban, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Jason Kidd on if he reached out to Luka Doncic after Mark Cuban’s comments:

“Understand that Luka is in the other side. He’s trying to kick our butt. We’re trying to kick his butt. Understand that there’s not going to be a phone call to Luka.”

Jason Kidd on Mark Cuban, Luka Doncic, Apr 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Austin Reaves on Luka Doncic
item.description:
Austin Reaves on Luka Doncic's trash talk:

“Half the time I don’t even know what the hell he’s saying. It’s never in English.”

Austin Reaves on Luka Doncic, Mar 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Matas Buzelis on Luka Doncic
item.description:
?Law Murray ???: Matas Buzelis on Luka Doncic:

“What was my take? ... I don't even know what to say, honestly. He started killing obviously when I started talking to him.”

Matas Buzelis on Luka Doncic, Mar 13, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Luka Doncic
item.description:
Khobi Price:Rick Carlisle on Luka Doncic:

“I don't know if I've seen a player control an NBA game the way he does.”

Rick Carlisle on Luka Doncic, Mar 6, 2026. Source: Twitter @khobi_price.

item.title: Rich Paul on JJ Redick, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Rich Paul on JJ Redick and Luka Doncic going at it on the sidelines:

“That leads to a healthy relationship. That means there’s a profound respect for the player and should be a profound respect for the coach. It ultimately leads to a healthy relationship….When things happen in such a media robust environment we’re looking for the drama of it all. The reality of it is, these guys are getting paid a lot of money to do a high level job, the fact that there’s care shown, passion shown, and competitive nature shown, I think that’s healthy”

Rich Paul on JJ Redick, Luka Doncic, Mar 2, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Sam Mitchell on Luka Doncic
item.description:
Sam Mitchell:

“Luka Dončić can’t play basketball without the ball. He doesn’t cut, he doesn’t move, he doesn’t set screens. He’s great with the ball, but he does nothing to make his teammates better when he doesn’t have it… Steph Curry does the hard things. He’s always cutting & moving off-ball”

Sam Mitchell on Luka Doncic, Dec 27, 2025. Source: reddit.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Luka Doncic
item.description:
Jason Kidd on Luka Doncic:

“When you look at Luka & the way he's playing, he's one of the best players in the world. If you show one pitch & you show it too many times, he's going to be able to take advantage of that. Hopefully we can through different defenses to throw him off, but he's seen everything... He's playing the game at a very high level.”

Jason Kidd on Luka Doncic, Nov 28, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Luka Doncic
item.description:
MrBuckBuck: Lakers GM Rob Pelinka on Luka Doncic's mindset in LA:

“He's in a comfort zone and you feel like you can see the Luka joy and just the way he plays. It's contagious. When he pulled up to practice [the other day]...I said you are now all LA”

Rob Pelinka on Luka Doncic, Nov 25, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Anthony Davis, Luka Doncic, Nico Harrison
item.description:
“Then he had the bad luck of Anthony Davis never being available basically. “Butthe thing that bothers me is he’s just being made a scapegoat. Listen, Shaq knows this, Kenny knows this, there’s no way in the world Nico Harrison had the power to trade Luka Doncic unless the owner of the team signed off on it. That was his call, so I feel bad the way Nico’s being made a scapegoat.”

Charles Barkley on Anthony Davis, Luka Doncic, Nico Harrison, Nov 14, 2025. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Deandre Ayton on Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves
item.description:
“[Austin Reaves] is my guy. [Luka Doncic] is my guy. But my wings and my forwards? Yeah,they be trying to get me ticked off before these games just to get me rolling. I’m starting to see it as a trend because I don’t get a break until we’re on the court. Then it’s all seriousness. “I’m like, ‘Oh, this is a thing y’all want to do. Y’all want to get me on edge. Y’all want me fired up.’ I like it. … Dudes really care.”

Deandre Ayton on Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves, Oct 27, 2025. Source: Larry Brown Sports.

item.title: JJ Redick on Luka Doncic
item.description:
JJ Redick on Luka Doncic's groin discomfort late in the Warriors loss:

“He seems to be fine. I don't think it's anything major. He got some treatment this morning and we didn't practice long, but he was a participant in practice.”

JJ Redick on Luka Doncic, Oct 22, 2025. Source: x.com.
